And not only that, you found the most terrifying existing thing in this place... a literal lean bear making a conga line with a withered and plastic chicken. Truly traumatizing, and it wasn't worse than that at all.

Suddenly, while you were spacing out, a large, rabbit-like figure jumped at you, tackling you to the ground. That's what you get for making Living Tombstone references you stupid FU-.

Take that, you toy chicken bitch! I knew I could catch the nightguard faster than her fat ass."

You began to get up. Why the hell weren't you dead? Actually, no animatronic ever killed you, probably cause of plot armor.
